content.text:
Playwright MCP now uses the user name and password from the `--proxy-server` URL. I haven't built or run anything, so the change is untested.

The fix is in `packages/playwright-core/src/tools/mcp/config.ts`, where the proxy option is built. It parses the URL and percent-decodes the user name and password into `proxy.username` and `proxy.password`. It then removes the credentials from `proxy.server`, so the server value no longer contains them. That value is set on both `launchOptions.proxy` and `contextOptions.proxy`.

If the value isn't a parseable URL, it is passed through unchanged, as before.

Two limits:
- Credentials in `PLAYWRIGHT_MCP_PROXY_SERVER` should also be picked up, because that variable feeds the same `proxyServer` option. I didn't check this.
- `href` normalizes the URL, so a bare `http://host:3128` would gain a trailing `/`. That only happens when credentials were present.
